data.name: HolEvade
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to HolEvade – a precision-based 3D physics platformer where careful planning, steady control, and spatial awareness are the keys to success!

Take control of a rolling ball and navigate through intricate, suspended platforms floating high above the clouds. Avoid treacherous holes, bypass moving obstacles, and carefully maneuver across narrow bridges in a vibrant, stylized world where one wrong tilt could send you falling into the abyss.

KEY FEATURES

  • Precision Physics Gameplay: Feel the true-to-life physics, momentum, and balance required to keep your ball on track and out of danger.

  • Intricate Level Design: Master narrow paths, moving platforms, rotating hazards, and dangerous gaps designed to test your dexterity and patience.

  • Vibrant & Stylized World: Immerse yourself in colorful, high-contrast environments featuring glowing elements, stunning skyboxes, and atmospheric cloudscapes.

  • Instant Respawns: No frustrating wait times! Fall off the edge? Instantly reset to your spawn point and jump right back into solving the maze.

  • Accessible Yet Challenging: Simple, intuitive controls make it easy to start rolling, but mastering each level demands focus and exact precision.
